title: Documentation Hub & AI Intelligence Upgrades
description: Unified documentation experience, smarter AI conversations with markdown support, and refined navigation for a cleaner interface.

items.title: Universal Documentation Hub
items.description: A dedicated page for all guides and release notes in one place.
details: New '/docs' route with sidebar navigation for Guides and Releases
Sparkle highlight on newest release for visual prominence
Deep linking support for sharing specific docs (/docs/guide/aws-credentials)
Premium glassy purple aesthetic with translucent backgrounds

items.title: Markdown Chat Rendering
items.description: AI responses now render with rich formatting for better readability.
details: Bold, italic, and inline code formatting

items.title: AI Follow-Up Explanations
items.description: Ask 'explain this' or 'how did you get that?' and receive intelligent responses.
details: Detects follow-up intent keywords (explain, how, why, elaborate)
Routes directly to analysis with previous query context
No more failures when asking about recent results

items.title: Navigation Cleanup
items.description: Streamlined navbar for a cleaner experience.
details: Removed 'Stocks' tab (feature hidden for future development)
Removed duplicate 'Docs' from main nav (accessible via user dropdown)

items.title: Frontend Enhancements
details: DocsView.vue with markdown-it for high-fidelity rendering
ChatEditor.vue markdown integration with styled components
Router updates for protected docs routes
